title: The best guide you can get
text: Enrique is the best guide I ever met. Friendly, kind and professional. The tour was simply great    and I hope I'll be able to meet other guides like Enrique in my next trips. Thank you very much to all of you for this wonderful experience.
author: Angelo_R

title: Fantastic tour with Pamen
text: Pamen was an excellent tour guide. We didn’t know when we would be in Seville and booked our tour only one day in advance. They were very accommodating with the last minute booking. We had some extra time so Pamen took us to the Plaza de Espana which was amazing.
author: TravelinFoodies

title: Fabulous
text: Wonderful tour with beautiful places visited. A great tour guide, Panoma?. She was fabulous and so knowledgeable about the architecture and history of each place we visited and Sevilla in general. A long day but worth every minute.
author: X1308BMjeffw

title: Pamen the best!
text: Our guide Pamen Moreno was incredible, with great passion and deep knowledge he showed us the wonderful Cathedral of Seville and the Alcazar. Without her the visit would have been very difficult instead Pamen managed to involve our 13 and 16 year olds. The tour was also perfect to his ability to avoid crowds. Thank you Pamen!
author: emanueledD3082VS

title: A Great Day
text: The tour guide Pamen was so very thoughtful, thorough, knowledgeable and accommodating.   She made the day a memorable experience because we were shown so many things.  Also she gave us the recommendation of a nice restaurant to have our lunch and made certain we could stop for a moment to be seated if we were tired.
author: adrian_b

title: Great day with Pamen and LivTours
text: We had a great day with our guide, Pamen.  She was extremely knowledgeable and very engaging.  We highly recommend, Pamen and LivTours!
